record.one_liner: Meta's Threads API for publishing and reading Threads posts, profiles, replies and insights.
record.auth_notes: Threads user access tokens obtained through the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Window, with scopes such as threads_basic and threads_content_publish.
record.access_notes: Apps are created in the developer dashboard and Threads testers (users with a role on the app) can grant permissions immediately for development/testing, but users without a role require each permission to pass App Review and the app to be published. critic: access kept approval_required; the tester path covers testing only, not real use by arbitrary users.
record.api_notes: Covers posts (text, image, video, carousel), media, profiles, replies, moderation, mentions, insights, webhooks and keyword search per the docs index.
record.blocker_notes: Permissions need Meta App Review and a published app for users without an app role. No official Meta MCP server found (search results from third parties state Meta has not shipped one); only community servers. critic: confirmed.
